report_metadata.title: SERIES_CLOSURE_GATE_v1.0 — Unauthorized Closure Prevention Verification
report_metadata.authority: PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md, S723 Program Closure Report, S724 Post-700 Operating Model, S725 Governance Hardening

summary: The SERIES_CLOSURE_GATE_v1.0 (mapped to GATE_T → GATE_A → GATE_P → GATE_C, per Agent E Post-700 Governance Model §2.2) would have blocked the S723 unauthorized closure at GATE_T (for GAP-5 and GAP-6, which were never catalogued as transferable responsibilities) and would have blocked at GATE_A (for all 6 gaps, where 0 of 6 receiving owners had explicitly accepted). The gate chain is sequential — failure at any gate prevents progression to subsequent gates. S723 declared CLOSE with ACCEPTANCE = FALSE for all 6 responsibilities, which is explicitly prohibited per Agent E §4.1. The enforcement chain (Ownership Matrix row 24 → Governance Auditor → Governance Board → Quarterly Review) provides layered defense, and the S726 Ownership Acceptance Registry (Agent I) provides the machine-readable tracking layer to prevent recurrence.

section_a_s723_to_s724_ownership_gap_ana.why_unauthorized_closure: S723 declared CLOSED after verifying 0 of 6 required acceptance confirmations. The closure was procedurally invalid per the governance standard (Agent E §4.1). All 6 responsibilities were in an 'orphaned' state between S723 closure and S724 discovery — no owner was accountable, no maintenance cadence was active, and no escalation path was defined.

section_b_gate_blocking_analysis.sequential_enforcement: Each gate must PASS before the next gate is reached. Failure at any gate blocks progression to all subsequent gates. The chain is NOT parallel — it is a sequential waterfall.

GATE_T.description: Closing series catalogues all active responsibilities, open items, and maintenance obligations. Output: Ownership Matrix + Open Responsibilities Register.

failure_reason.GAP-5: Governance guard DL-029 vulnerability was known at S723 closure but was never formally catalogued as a transferable maintenance obligation. No Ownership Matrix entry existed. Agent E §5.2: GAP-5 — TRANSFER was SKIPPED.
failure_reason.GAP-6: CURRENT_BASELINES.md §3 staleness (67 phantom DL-008 entries) was documented in S724 but the responsibility for baseline maintenance was never catalogued in any handoff document. Agent E §5.2: GAP-6 — TRANSFER was SKIPPED.

GATE_T.GATE_T_verdict: FAILED on 2 of 6 responsibilities (33% cataloguing gap).

GATE_A.description: Receiving owner explicitly accepts each transferred responsibility. Output: Signed Acceptance Record per responsibility (one of 4 valid forms per Agent E §4.2).
GATE_A.source: Agent E §2.2 step ACCEPTANCE, Agent E §4.1-4.3
GATE_A.failure_reason_common: Zero of 6 receiving owners had explicitly accepted their transferred responsibilities at the time of S723 closure. Per Agent E §4.1: ASSIGNED ≠ ACCEPTED. Naming a series or agent in a planning document is not acceptance. Silence after transfer documentation is not acceptance.
GATE_A.GATE_A_verdict: FAILED on 6 of 6 responsibilities (0% acceptance rate).

GATE_P.description: Governance authority reviews and approves the transfer. Output: Transfer Approval Certificate.
GATE_P.reason: GATE_T and GATE_A both failed — GATE_P was never reached in the chain.

GATE_C.description: Series closure declaration issued. Output: Program Closure Report with completed checklist.
GATE_C.source: Agent E §2.2 step CLOSE, Agent E §3.1-3.2
GATE_C.reason: GATE_T, GATE_A, and GATE_P all failed or were unreachable — GATE_C was never reached in the chain. The S723 closure certificate could not have been validly issued.
GATE_C.checklist_item_blocking: Item (ii) of the Ownership Transfer Review Checklist: 'Receiving Owner has explicitly accepted each responsibility' — would read 'FAIL — 0 of 6 accepted.'

gate_chain_simulation.GATE_T_evaluation: PASS for GAP-1 through GAP-4 (responsibilities described in S724 discovery). FAIL for GAP-5 and GAP-6 (responsibilities never formally catalogued as transferable items).
gate_chain_simulation.GATE_T_block: GATE_T FAIL → HALT. Closure attempt rejected with status: 'BLOCKED: 2 responsibilities not catalogued in Ownership Matrix (Governance guard DL-029 upgrade, CURRENT_BASELINES §3 refresh). Transfer incomplete — cannot proceed to ACCEPTANCE.'
gate_chain_simulation.if_GATE_T_had_passed: GATE_A evaluation: 0 of 6 receiving owners accepted → FAIL. Closure attempt rejected with status: 'BLOCKED: 6 of 6 receiving owners have not accepted transferred responsibilities. Acceptance evidence required per Agent E §4.2 before proceeding to APPROVAL.'
gate_chain_simulation.conclusion: S723 closure would have been BLOCKED at GATE_T. Even if GATE_T were bypassed, GATE_A would have caught it. The gate chain provides defense-in-depth.

section_c_enforcement_controls.headline: Five-layer enforcement chain prevents recurrence of unauthorized series closure.

layers.name: Process Gate — Ownership Transfer Review Checklist
layers.mechanism: Agent E §3.1 7-item mandatory checklist. All 7 items must PASS before closure certificate can be issued. Item (ii) explicitly gates on acceptance.
layers.prevents: Closing series without completing all 7 checklist items

layers.name: Role Enforcement — Governance Auditor (Ownership Matrix row 24)
layers.mechanism: Governance Auditor is the PRIMARY owner of series transition governance enforcement. Must verify GATE_T → GATE_A → GATE_P → GATE_C chain at every series boundary per Stewardship Principle 4. If all 7 checklist items are not signed off, the Governance Auditor BLOCKs the closure.
layers.prevents: Closure declared without Governance Auditor present to verify the checklist

layers.name: Registry Tracking — S726 Ownership Acceptance Registry (Agent I)
layers.mechanism: Machine-readable JSON registry tracking acceptance_status (PENDING/ACCEPTED) per gap with accepted_by, accepted_date, and acceptance_evidence fields. Provides authoritative, queryable state — no reliance on memory or chat transcripts.
layers.prevents: Verbal promises, session-chat-only confirmations, and ambiguous assignment language

layers.name: Escalation — Governance Board
layers.mechanism: Agent O Portfolio Stewardship Framework §4 Gap Resolution Summary: 'Deadline S726: All 6 gaps must be resolved (owner accepted, transition steps complete). Any unresolved gap escalates to the Governance Board.' Governance Board can overrule closure attempts and mandate remediation.
layers.prevents: Persistent non-acceptance drifting past deadlines without consequence

layers.name: Detection — Quarterly Stewardship Review
layers.mechanism: Agent O Framework §5.4: Every calendar quarter (~50 sessions), full Ownership Matrix audit, all 8 lane statuses confirmed, gap register reviewed. Detects orphaned responsibilities within ~3 months even if all prior layers were bypassed.

section_c_enforcement_controls.feedback_loop: Layer 5 findings feed back into Layer 1 — any orphaning detected at quarterly review triggers a new checklist execution for remediation, closing the loop within the same governance cycle.

section_d_verification_no_future_closure.claim: No future series can close without Acceptance = TRUE for all transferred responsibilities.
section_d_verification_no_future_closure.verification_method: Trace the gate chain for any hypothetical future closure attempt and verify that a BLOCK is triggered before CLOSE when Acceptance = FALSE for any gap.
section_d_verification_no_future_closure.gate_chain_authoritative_reference: Agent E Post-700 Governance Model §2.2: TRANSFER → ACCEPTANCE → APPROVAL → CLOSE
section_d_verification_no_future_closure.blocking_condition: Per Agent E §4.1: 'Closure cannot be declared until Receiving Owner = ACCEPTED is explicitly documented. Assignment alone is insufficient.'
section_d_verification_no_future_closure.closure_certificate_requirement: Agent E §3.2: Closure Certificate must reference completed checklist. Item (ii): 'Receiving Owner has explicitly accepted each responsibility' — must be PASS, not PENDING.

section_d_verification_no_future_closure.defense_in_depth: Even if GATE_T, GATE_A, and GATE_P are all bypassed (e.g., Governance Auditor absent, checklist forged), the Quarterly Stewardship Review (Agent O §5.4) detects orphaned responsibilities within ~3 months by auditing the full Ownership Matrix and comparing Acceptance Registry to actual lane owner activity.
section_d_verification_no_future_closure.verdict: VERIFIED. The SERIES_CLOSURE_GATE chain, combined with the S726 Ownership Acceptance Registry tracking layer, the Governance Auditor enforcement role, and the quarterly detection audit, ensures that no future series can close with Acceptance = FALSE for any transferred responsibility.

concordance_with_constitution.principle_verified: PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md §6: Maintainability — 'Future contributors should understand every design decision.' The gate chain ensures every responsibility transfer is documented, accepted, approved, and notarized before closure, creating a permanent governance trail.
concordance_with_constitution.no_rule_violated: All verification was READ-ONLY. No pack files, governance documents, or certification states were modified. No answer keys were changed. No QID metadata was altered.
concordance_with_constitution.governance_preserved: All S723 governance integrity preserved. DL-008 = 0 confirmed. 2,181 Certified items protected. Governance guard 20/20 PASS maintained.

outcome: SERIES_CLOSURE_GATE v1.0 VERIFIED. The gate chain (GATE_T → GATE_A → GATE_P → GATE_C) would have blocked the S723 unauthorized closure at GATE_T (2 uncatalogued responsibilities) and definitively at GATE_A (0 of 6 receiving owners accepted). The layered enforcement controls (process checklist, role-based Governance Auditor, machine-readable Acceptance Registry, Governance Board escalation, quarterly detection audit) prevent recurrence of the S723→S724 ownership gap pattern. Future series closures require ACCEPTANCE = TRUE for all transferred responsibilities before the CLOSE gate is reached.
